admission_evidence.completeness_rule: All v3 pages must agree on total_records and total_pages; unique incident-impact IDs required

notes: The public page states CC BY 4.0, KeyID header, 20 calls per 60 seconds and a 60-second refresh. Account access was demonstrated by private probes; production quota, attribution and retention still require admission review. v3 endTime and nextUpdateDue are estimates, not evidence that an incident resolved. Review 2026-10-01: this source's own HTML dictionary and OpenAPI do not specify offsetless timestamp timezone; source_updated_at and absolute event times remain null for those values, and original fields remain in JSON summary. Unknown status and conflicting parent incident versions reject a snapshot. Every complete read, including empty, emits a complete-road-snapshot-v1 SourceRecord and road_snapshot_membership links; new fetches produce new snapshot revisions while business versions stay stable. Disappearance means absent from current snapshot, not resolved. KeyID requests reject redirects and allow one HTTP attempt per page; callers receive Retry-After on rate limiting. See cloud/data/docs/source-policies/transport-unplanned-roads.md. Admission 2026-10-16: CC BY 4.0 per the landing page; the stored KeyID returned HTTP 200 on 2026-10-16, with 309 records on 4 pages of 100. The cadence is 10 minutes, not the provider's 60 seconds, because every road publication rebuilds this source's geo_records_current rows (about 0.5 GB billed); one-minute runs would bill about 0.7 TB a day. The three Transport Victoria jobs share one KeyID limited to 20 calls per 60 seconds. Instead of a cross-job coordinator, the schedules keep the combined peak near 16: planned roads at about 10 a minute, unplanned roads 4 pages a run, GTFS-R 2 feeds.
